quizDescription: A psychometric and career-interest test to support subject and career decisions before higher studies.

items.content: I enjoy analysing data to reach a reasoned conclusion.
I prefer problems that have a logical, provable answer.
I like breaking a complex problem into smaller logical parts.
Building a step-by-step method or algorithm appeals to me.
I appreciate the structure and harmony within a piece of music.
I would enjoy composing, arranging, or producing music.
I can identify changes in pitch, tempo, and rhythm easily.
Sound and rhythm strongly shape how I experience things.
I am drawn to biology, ecology, or environmental topics.
I enjoy observing and classifying patterns in nature.
Protecting the environment matters a great deal to me.
I would enjoy fieldwork studying plants, animals, or ecosystems.
I communicate complex ideas well in writing or speech.
I enjoy analysing literature, arguments, or language.
Learning and using new vocabulary or languages appeals to me.
I would enjoy a career built around words and communication.
I read other people's emotions and motivations accurately.
I am effective at collaborating and building teams.
I enjoy roles where I guide, mentor, or coordinate others.
I adapt easily to different people and social situations.
I have strong physical coordination and control.
I would enjoy work that is practical and hands-on.
I learn skills fastest by practising them physically.
Making, building, or performing with my body appeals to me.
I can mentally rotate and manipulate three-dimensional shapes.
I tend to think in images and visualise solutions.
I would enjoy design, architecture, or other visual fields.
I interpret diagrams, plans, and spatial data easily.
I have a clear sense of my values and goals.
I reflect deeply on my thoughts and choices.
I understand my emotions and what drives me.
I make decisions guided by self-knowledge.
I reflect on the meaning and purpose of life.
I am drawn to philosophical or spiritual questions.
I think about humanity's place in the universe.
Questions with no easy answer intrigue me.
I would enjoy engineering, mechanical, or technical work.
I prefer concrete, hands-on work over abstract discussion.
Operating machinery or building structures appeals to me.
I like solving real, physical problems with tools.
I would enjoy research or scientific investigation.
I like analysing evidence and data to answer questions.
Understanding theories and how things work appeals to me.
I am drawn to careers in science, medicine, or research.
I would enjoy a creative career in art, design, or media.
I like producing original, expressive work.
Creative freedom matters to me in what I do.
I am drawn to fields that value imagination.
I would enjoy a career in teaching, healthcare, or counselling.
Helping others grow and develop matters to me.
I am drawn to work that serves people and communities.
Supporting and guiding others is fulfilling for me.
I would enjoy business, management, or entrepreneurship.
I like leading teams and driving results.
Persuading and negotiating come naturally to me.
I am drawn to roles with leadership and influence.
I would enjoy work in accounting, administration, or data.
I like structured tasks with clear procedures.
I value accuracy, order, and careful record-keeping.
Managing details and systems appeals to me.
